prompt:
# Mevan Sword: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10178/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the exact isolated and mechanically rotated MM9 Mevan Sword PCX as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite without redesigning it. Preserve its plain gray blade, curved brown guard, alternating striped grip, and small dark pommel. Keep the simple ominous silhouette. Render one complete vertical sword with restrained late-1990s pre-rendered realism and genuine transparent alpha. No ornate generic replacement, text, glow, shadow, frame, scenery, hands, or watermark..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the exact isolated and mechanically rotated MM9 Mevan Sword PCX as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite without redesigning it. Preserve its plain gray blade, curved brown guard, alternating striped grip, and small dark pommel. Keep the simple ominous silhouette. Render one complete vertical sword with restrained late-1990s pre-rendered realism and genuine transparent alpha. No ornate generic replacement, text, glow, shadow, frame, scenery, hands, or watermark.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10178/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the EXACT edit target; image 2 design_reference.png is appearance reference; image 3 icon_x8.png is original colour reference. Preserve the entire guide canvas and all ten silhouettes, including the very narrow edge views and tiny end views. The instruction 'one complete vertical sword' describes the reference design, NOT replacing the atlas with one sword. Output the whole 3-column 4-row atlas. Transparent background.
CORRECTIVE PASS: Match guide silhouettes strictly. Horizontal blade edge views must remain hairline thin, exactly as in the grey guide, not broad blade faces. All material masks must match their paired paint silhouette exactly and have no stray pixels anywhere outside. Leather grip bands must be flat pure green in ALL visible mask views including horizontal views; all metal pure red. Keep exact original positions in four equal rows. No highlights, ambient shading or reflections in painted base colours.
